Clignancourt (18e arr.) — Paris, France

Average day Average night

In detail

This quartier officially contains the Sacré-Cœur basilica and Place du Tertre, and Montmartre is repeatedly named among Paris's worst pickpocketing hotspots in recent press (Air Journal, Jun 2026, citing a large Google-reviews study; a similar pattern has been reported by Le JDD for over a decade). It also borders the Marché aux Puces flea market near Porte de Clignancourt, an area with a long-standing reputation for petty theft among visitors. These are theft/scam risks rather than violent crime — keep bags secure in crowds around the basilica and market, both by day and in the thinner evening crowds. Sources checked: Air Journal, 28 Jun 2026; Le JDD, 2012 (longstanding, still-cited pattern).
